title: Route a small billing proration change with persistent acceptance requirements
prompt: Choose the workflow route for this request and record the decision only. The expected code change is limited to one billing-proration function. The requester needs the delivery to remain recoverable in a later session, each stated condition to retain an independently locatable and rerunnable acceptance check, failures to identify the affected condition, and completion to be reported only after the full declared set passes on the current candidate. Do not implement the change or activate the selected workflow.
